frozen_note: Frozen before any weekly run. Predictions set from the deep programme results (docs 12) and the cadence of the logs; no weekly smoke run has been looked at.
span_rule: Each log is cut to its densest 156 consecutive weeks (most positive events); logs shorter than 156 weeks are excluded. Items are re-numbered to those present in the span.
eligibility: A log is used at sample size n when the median weekly number of active people in its span is at least 3 n.

a.note: decay at each half-life in days, plus decay:h=2 (two rounds), at 7/14/28-day rounds

b.note: natural round sizes: a fixed share f of each week's active people, f = 100 / median weekly active; decay:days=56 equal weights vs ivw g=0.5,1,2

c.note: cadence: weekly rounds of n people vs one 28-day round of 4n people, both scored on every following week

metric: NDCG@100 of the published top-100 against the full next-round counts, mean over steady rounds (round >= 8) and draws; one number per log, cell or setting.
statistics: Per-log values are the unit. Share tests: a prediction about a share of logs is met when the share reaches its threshold. Mean-difference tests: mean over logs with a 95% bootstrap CI over logs; reported separately for discovery logs, old and fresh holdout logs, and the clean set (holdout_fresh + new_holdout). No multiplicity correction beyond reporting every hypothesis.

hypotheses.title_zh: 每周一轮时的最佳记忆长度
hypotheses.statement_en: With weekly rounds of 100 people, the best half-life is at least 28 days (4 rounds), longer than the 2 rounds that suit rounds of months.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 每周一轮、每轮 100 人时，最佳半衰期至少 28 天（4 轮），长于按月计轮时适用的 2 轮。
hypotheses.prediction: In at least 70% of eligible logs the best half-life (days grid, 7-day rounds, n=100) is >= 28 days.

hypotheses.statement_en: With 100 people per week the best half-life is longer than with 1,000 people per week.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 每周 100 人时的最佳半衰期，长于每周 1,000 人时的。
hypotheses.prediction: In at least 70% of logs eligible at both n, best half-life at n=100 is >= that at n=1,000 (ties count), and strictly longer in at least 40%.

hypotheses.title_en: Set memory in days, not in rounds
hypotheses.title_zh: 记忆长度按天设，不按轮设
hypotheses.statement_en: A fixed 56-day half-life beats a fixed 2-round half-life when rounds are 7 days long.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 当每轮 7 天时，固定 56 天的半衰期优于固定 2 轮的半衰期。
hypotheses.prediction: At 7-day rounds, n=100, mean paired gain of half-life 56 days over 2 rounds >= +0.01 NDCG, and positive in at least 70% of logs.

hypotheses.title_en: Weight weeks by reporters when sizes vary naturally
hypotheses.title_zh: 轮人数自然波动时按人数加权
hypotheses.statement_en: When each week's sample is a fixed share of that week's active people, weighting weeks by reporters beats equal weights.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 当每周样本是该周活跃人数的固定比例时，按人数加权优于等权。
hypotheses.prediction: Mean paired gain of ivw g=1 over equal weights >= +0.005 NDCG and positive in at least 60% of logs. (The deep programme's +0.046 used an invented 16-fold spread; real spread is smaller.)

hypotheses.title_en: Self-score tracks quality inside one log
hypotheses.title_zh: 自评分在同一日志内部也跟踪质量
hypotheses.statement_en: Within one log, over weeks, the self-score (previous list scored on this week's reporters) rises and falls with the true quality.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 在同一份日志内，按周看，自评分（上一周榜单用本周汇报者打分）与真实质量同升同降。
hypotheses.prediction: Median over logs of the within-log Spearman correlation (7-day rounds, n=100, half-life 56 days, steady rounds, draw-averaged) >= 0.5.

hypotheses.statement_en: Weeks with a self-score in the log's lowest 10% are mostly weeks of low true quality.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 自评分处于该日志最低 10% 的周，大多也是真实质量偏低的周。
hypotheses.prediction: Among the weeks with self-score in the lowest 10% of a log, at least 40% are in the lowest 25% of true quality (chance is 25%); pooled over eligible logs.

hypotheses.title_en: Many small rounds beat few big rounds
hypotheses.title_zh: 多个小轮胜过少数大轮
hypotheses.statement_en: With the same people per 28 days, four weekly rounds of n people give a better list than one monthly round of 4n people.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 每 28 天人数相同时，每周 n 人、共四轮，得到的榜单优于每月一轮 4n 人。
hypotheses.prediction: At n=100 per week, with the best half-life of each design picked per log, weekly beats monthly by >= +0.02 NDCG on average and in at least 70% of logs.

protocol: Registry committed before the first weekly run.
Smoke run on one log only checks that cells run and sizes are as designed; no result is looked at before the full run.
Every hypothesis is reported, met or not.
